decisions.reason: The Magento 2 shop template is a cheap digital asset with uncertain but still unresolved demand, so it costs little to keep the option open.
The responsive website template is only mentioned briefly, but upkeep is minimal and one year of evidence is too little to justify abandoning it.
Premium support ties up staff and so costs more to maintain, but it can be scaled down flexibly and its value from retaining customers is still uncertain, so the option stays open for now.
The version management tool has its own page, which signals a larger commitment and growth potential close to the firm's core software business, so continuing to invest is warranted.
The GDPR data processing contract tool meets demand created by the 2018 regulation and is cheap to run, although demand may fade once the compliance rush passes, so it is kept and monitored.
